# restate_server_info (Data Source)

Version and capability information for the Restate server behind the provider's `admin_url`.

This is a read-only diagnostic. It is useful for asserting a minimum server version in a configuration, or for reading the advertised ingress endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Version and capability information for the Restate server behind the provider's admin_url.

data "restate_server_info" "environment" {}

output "restate_version" {
  value = data.restate_server_info.environment.version
}

output "ingress_endpoint" {
  value = data.restate_server_info.environment.ingress_endpoint
}

# Assert a minimum server version before depending on a newer feature.
check "server_is_recent_enough" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.restate_server_info.environment.max_admin_api_version >= 4
    error_message = "This configuration needs Admin API version 4 or newer. The server advertises up to ${data.restate_server_info.environment.max_admin_api_version}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `features` (Map of Boolean) The server's experimental features and whether each is enabled.
- `ingress_endpoint` (String) Ingress endpoint the server advertises for invoking services. Empty when the server reports none.
- `max_admin_api_version` (Number) Highest Admin API version the server accepts.
- `min_admin_api_version` (Number) Lowest Admin API version the server accepts.
- `negotiated_admin_api_version` (Number) Highest Admin API version both the server and this provider support. This provider's API client was generated against version 4 (Restate 1.7.6) and supports versions 2 to 4.
- `version` (String) Restate server version, for example `1.7.6`.
